'''Red Two''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the second member of Red Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Red Two.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] flew a [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] at the [[First Battle of Kamino|Battle of Kamino]]<ref name="Rep50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref> under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] "Red Two".<ref name="CSWERed2">{{CSWECite|III|88|Red Two (1)}}</ref>

A Delta-7 interceptor pilot flying as "Red Two" in [[Rebellion on Felucia|pursuit]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] was commended for precise gunnery by a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] mate.<ref name="Kinect" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] maintained a [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] aboard the [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]. During his training aboard the ''Independence'', [[Flight Cadet]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] encountered veteran [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Halley Kadorto]], who had flown under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] Red Two for his famous [[rescue at Mon Calamari]].<ref name="XW">[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']]</ref><ref name="XWOSG">''[[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref>

As a member of the ''Independence''{{'s}} Red Squadron, Farlander himself flew as Red Two on his [[Battle in the Turkana system|first mission]], and a later [[Rescue of Sian Tevv|rescue of a Sullustan leader]]. The call sign was also frequently used by Farlander's [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]]: [[Sunnar Jan-lo]], for the [[capture of Cygnus Staff]] and the [[Battle of Kalla VII|destruction of the ''Intrepid'']], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Cardacs]], who died in action on a [[Rescue from Stars' End|rescue mission to Star's End]], and [[Toalagar]], who was killed by missiles from an [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] during a [[Rescue of enslaved Wookiees|mission to rescue]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="XW" /><ref name="XWOSG" />

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Red Squadron had been transferred to the Alliance's [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in preparation for the coming [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|assault]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. During this time, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] used the call sign Red Two, participating in a [[Mission to Commenor (0 BBY)|mission]] to [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]] to acquire [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]],<ref name="XWRS.5">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron ½|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' ½]]</ref> and the subsequent Battle of Yavin, where he was forced to pull out of the final trench run when his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] took damage, but was among the pivotal battle's few survivors.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> After the destruction of the Death Star, Antilles patrolled the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] as Red Two, encountering the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|forces]] of crime lord [[Tyber Zann]].<ref name="EAW">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref> Antilles would return to the call sign [[0 ABY/Legends|seven months after the Battle of Yavin]] for a [[Battle of Lubang Minor (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to establish a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on [[Lubang Minor]],<ref name="E:GS">[[Empire 27|''Empire'' 27]]</ref> and again, years later, at the end of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], saving [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] from pursuing [[Yorik-et|coralskippers]].<ref name="NJO:TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

Due to a lack of personnel following the Battle of Yavin, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was temporarily recruited into Red Squadron, flying as Red Two for a [[Reconnaissance mission to Kamino|reconnaissance mission]] to [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="RF:F">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>

[[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] flew an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] under the call sign Red Two in the [[Rescue at Bundil II|rescue]] of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] personnel from ''[[Bundil II]]'', the [[Defense of the Liberty|defense of the ''Liberty'']], and the [[Battle of Eidoloni]]. He also flew under the call sign in a [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighter]] for a mission to liberate the slaves of convoy [[KDT Group]], and in an [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptor]] during the scramble to capture brainwashed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] double agent [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kupalo]].<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>

A [[Red Two (Battle of Endor)|seemingly unknown]] [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]] pilot was called Red Two in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] who was noted for taking a "good shot" by Antilles, who by then was leading the squadron as [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

A [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying as Red Two in the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Onderon]] was struck by the size of the ''[[Eclipse II]]'' and was reprimanded by Wedge Antilles to "cut the chatter", mirroring an exchange between Antilles and [[Red Leader/Legends|Red Leader]] [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]] during the Battle of Yavin.<ref name="EE">[[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]]</ref>

During [[Red Flight]]'s diplomatic mission to [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] used the call sign.<ref name="XW:SoA">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars:'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] identifies the film's [[Gold Two/Legends|Gold Two]], [[Tiree/Legends|Tiree]], as Red Two.<ref name="ANH" /><ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>
